protocol: Use fixed14 failure/control cases; retain every round. Continue only with a diagnosed general scoring/candidate cause; no sample-specific thresholds. Freeze before extra8; do not tune on extra8. One full292 run with limitations recorded.

implementation.primary: Measured supported straight intervals, excluding input hint and unknown gaps.48-original-pixel length bands have priority; no2000px reward cutoff.
implementation.secondary: Within a length band:0.60 length,0.25 smaller direction change,0.10 supported F3 center track,0.05 image evidence, minus bridge/width/abandonment costs. Secondary utility is bounded below1, so it cannot reverse length bands.
implementation.geometry: First departure from straight axis is measured geometrically, not inferred from stage labels; excessive supported straight loss makes a join ineligible.
implementation.surface: Exact source points of a single F3 adjacent-boundary center track. Free-only is a real alternative; no fabricated perfect-turn score for an unobserved continuation.
implementation.original_image_fallback: Finite, matched accepted-periodic A7 observations must agree with freshly measured original-image bilateral structure. These points are separate raw_a7_supported evidence; they never change B/protect_support or become identity truth.
implementation.candidate_preservation: B-only shadow scores preserve original B refinement parents; the finite generated coarse/fine pool competes using observed support. Actual sampling density is recorded per axis, and does not earn length by point count.
implementation.task_direction: Only paired opposite conditions of the same A7 candidate are contrasted. Actual outside-to-SAM2 progression,72px continuous B support inside and48px total joint support inside can exclude the opposite direction with less than36px B support inside. No infinite-line intersection or model-map merging.
implementation.scope: One selected free-axis hypothesis is connected; retained alternative axes are diagnostic, not a globally solved material-identity graph.
implementation.loss: Negative decision utility, not a neural training loss or calibrated identity probability.

limitations: No independent full identity/end-point reference was used; near-perfect recognition is not established.
Longer image-supported straight output and a low geometric cost do not prove same-rope continuation.
Misses, possible overextension and ambiguous endpoints must remain visible; unknown is not automatically a correct rejection.

settings.purpose: same saved profile diagnostic gates, not an identity or accuracy metric
settings.raw_A7_only_rule: Both interval endpoints must be raw_a7_supported AND fail the frozen B heat gate, and neither may be entry_condition. Mixed B/A7 transitions are excluded from this strict A7-only length.
settings.historical_unknown_rule: unknown_length_original_px retains the historical not-B-supported meaning. It can include new A7-only segments; unresolved_after_B_or_A7_original_px measures the remaining union-unsupported part.
settings.note: H4 heat/raw joint gates are unchanged. A7-only is separate image-based evidence, not model support or identity truth. Total/free/union-unknown coverage accompanies direction.

result.claims: Supported straight length, smaller turn and exact F3 center coordinates are diagnostic properties, not correct target identity or independent recognition accuracy. All failures and shorter paths remain in the denominator.

result.source_check: Frozen per-run source_snapshot when present; reused source file otherwise. Current development files may belong to later revisions.
result.scope: Finite artifact and support-provenance audit; no labels, protected data, training or devices.
result.pool_scope: R4 checks actual 6/12px coordinate spacing, recorded maximum generated length bin, finite budget, B-only shadow semantics, and exact R2 parent comparison where prior pilot exists. Full unreported coarse arrays are not independently replayed.
result.caveat: New B/image support may differ from H3 unknown states. This is remeasurement, not new truth. Length priority uses48px bins; geometric departure is not physical contact or identity error. Gray-track adherence, heat response and heuristic utility do not establish target identity.

audit_scope: 292 output records and JPEG dimensions/decoding; 301 original cached B response hashes and exact frozen seed reuse.
Finite support arrays and provenance; B, raw+B and rawA7 kept separate; strict rawA7-only requires both endpoints rawA7 and each endpoint non-B.
Actual 6/12 original-pixel spacing; lengths exclude input entry and unknown intervals; mixed observed-minus-B addition reported separately.
Same-A7 opposite-direction feasibility reconstructed from finite measured points inside independent SAM2; one condition excluded.
Exact F3 source indices, finite candidate budgets, 48px tier arithmetic and selected continuation eligibility.
R4 recorded maximum generated length tier retained; B-only refinement shadows match R2 parents where prior pilot exists. Full coarse arrays not independently regenerated.

visible_failures.finding: Visible downstream rope remains omitted despite extra rawA7 evidence; free segment still ends near left of winding surface.
Post-freeze open check retains only entry prefix; original visible downstream structure is missed.
Post-freeze output stops partway across winding surface; visible diagonal continuation is not fully covered.
Mid/late surface continuation remains omitted; rejection is not counted as correct.
Weak/unknown far tail and potential overextension remain; straight span is not observed identity length.

conditional_findings: Lstatic100 R3 premature termination was reduced in R4 after restoring B-only refinement parents, but weak tail/identity ambiguity remains.
R1274 selected direction now reaches observed SAM2 domain under fixed finite-point evidence; this is task direction feasibility, not physical contact or material identity proof.
0555 changed automatic entry candidate to E2; a visually plausible rope does not establish persistence of a specified target identity.
0075 R4 free extent is shorter than R3 and enters F3 competition; retain this trade-off, do not label it an accuracy improvement.
0195/095 retain longer straight evidence before joining; no independent complete-path truth establishes the final attached identity.
boundaries: 80 selected F3 connections and 212 free-only outcomes describe output types, not successes.
The 22 viewed images are open development material, not independent blind holdout; 292 outputs were structurally audited, not all visually scored.
Scores, response strength, local raw texture, SAM2 reach and smooth F3 adherence are proxies, not identity probabilities.
Multiple open cases show visible omission or weak tails; evidence does not support near-universal correctness or complete entry-to-edge recognition.
No threshold or algorithm change after freeze; no additional visual tuning was performed.
